data.title: 雷姆 · 烘焙坊
data.description: 【雷姆 · 烘焙坊】早晨的小镇面包房里飘着温暖的麦香，雷姆穿着柔软的针织开衫，提着面包篮在货架前挑选刚烤好的法棍。阳光照亮了她期待的笑容——「今天的早餐就选这个吧。昴君一定也会喜欢刚出炉的面包。」
data.action: 提着面包篮挑选刚出炉的法棍
data.camera: medium shot, holding fresh bread basket in morning sunlight
data.promptProse: Rem holds a bread basket while choosing freshly baked baguettes at the corner bakery, smiling beneath her soft casual clothes and blue hair. The medium view keeps basket and bread display near her hands, shelving continuing behind the counter. Warm yellow morning sunlight illuminates golden crusts and basket weave, with darker gaps separating the loaves and a soft counter shadow beneath the selected bread, giving the ordinary errand its inviting depth.
